deck_title: Rayleigh-Plateau lambda* = 9.015*R cylindrical liquid jet pinch-off vs naive fixed-wavelength pinch rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Joseph Plateau (1873) & Lord Rayleigh (1878) cylindrical liquid-jet capillary instability law (fastest-growing modified-Bessel wavenumber k* R = 0.6970 < 1 and droplet pinch-off wavelength lambda* = (2*pi / 0.6970) * R = 9.015 * R = lambda_0 * (1 + u), locking lambda_RP / lambda_model = 1.0000x across all 17 jet-radius stations R/R_0 = 1 + u in [1.000, 2.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive fixed-wavelength axial sine modulation (lambda = lambda_0, which underestimates droplet wavelength by 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 where k_0*R = 1.394 > 1 violates Plateau stability across 16/17 stations) and 64-slice Young-Laplace varicose surface-energy quadrature.

good_fit: Pouring water streams, leaky faucet drips, fountain jet breakup, and crown-splash ligament droplet spawning shaders
Scaling axial varicose pinch wavelength linearly with local jet radius lambda* = 9.015 * R (k*R = 0.6970) and volume-conserving droplet radius r_drop = 1.89 * R
Coupling capillary growth timescale tau = sqrt(rho * R^3 / sigma) / 0.343 to jet radius R^(3/2)
not_for: Rigid metal pipes or solid cylindrical rods
High-Weber-number atomizing fuel sprays governed by aerodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz stripping
